x: Cooper-Clark, our champion, is out of town this season and Dunkley, a top-notcher, is kept off the track by illness. But men who were just out of it last season can improve enough, by proper training, to take the places of this pair.
First man home was Ches Walker, our " novice " discovery and he ran well to beat Dunkley of the Poly, who was a member of their last year's Brighton Relay team.
He was in the lead for the first mile with Dunkley of Shaftesbury, but then Wood of Sheffield went past and opened up the field in the course of his record breaking run.
